noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

doNotDefaultIfMissing.description:
Indicates {@link Config#getConfig} should return null if it does not exist.
If set to true, takes into consideration configs in both config store and pkg for the specific config key when
determining existence.

secret.description: Indicates that this value is a secret and should be stored in the Vault.

minOverride.description: Minimum configuration override level. Default is {@link ConfigOverride#APP}.

maxOverride.description: Maximum configuration override level. Default is {@link ConfigOverride#ROOT}.

folder.description: Folder override where to read configuration from. By default this will be config type name.

subFolder.description:
Sub folder override where to read configuration from. Only makes sense if one of base Config types has
@config(folder) annotation.

authz.description: Minimum permission required to set configuration values.

secretAuthz.description: Minimum permission required to read and set secret values.

merge.description:
Indicates if config collection field should be merged from all elements in overrides. Only valid for collection
fields.

title: The @config annotation is used to specify configuration parameter behavior.
name: Ann.Config
